summary: The reference video used for reference-to-video, editing, or extension.
combines: Container/encoding: MP4 (`video/mp4`) and QuickTime MOV (`video/quicktime`); video H.264/AVC or H.265/HEVC; audio AAC or MP3 (the 2.5 tutorial also lists PCM for MOV).
Resolution: 1520757 and 2298881 say `480p`, `720p`, `1080p`, `4k`; the 2.5 tutorial (2607688) restricts 2.5 input to `480p`, `720p`. The docs disagree; treat 2.5 input above 720p as unverified.
Duration: 2.5 non-editing 2–30 s per video, 2.5 editing 4–30 s per video, up to 10 videos, total <= 30 s. 2.0 series 2–15 s per video, up to 3 videos, total <= 15 s.
Dimensions: aspect ratio `[0.4, 2.5]`, width/height `[300, 6000]` px, total pixels `[614x664=407696, 3326x2494=8295044]`.
Size <= 200 MB per video; frame rate `[24, 60]` FPS.
Face-containing videos are accepted only when they are trusted model outputs (see Trusted model outputs) or `asset://` assets.
2.5 accepts up to 10 reference videos, 2 to 30 seconds each and 30 seconds in total. The 2.0 series accepts up to 3, 2 to 15 seconds each and 15 seconds in total.
